# UI-TARS source snapshot

Source: https://github.com/bytedance/UI-TARS-desktop

Commit: `3ac2cb8d946d78d5ff92ad17b318eaafa18c178c`

Includes the SDK, shared definitions, action parser and NutJS desktop operator. Source files are copied unchanged. Upstream manifests are retained for provenance and are not npm workspaces. Dooo bundles these through `packages/ui-tars/build.js`; its approval and transport adapters live outside the vendor directory. Licensed under Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and retained source headers.
